title: Center the card
summary: Put the card dead centre in its stage, both ways.
brief: The card sits in the top-left corner of .stage. Move it to the exact centre, horizontally and vertically.
hints: Centering is the parent's job: style .stage, not .card.
Make .stage a flex or grid container.
display: flex with justify-content: center and align-items: center. Or display: grid with place-items: center.
solutionNotes: place-items: center on a grid container centres the child in its cell on both axes. The flex version needs two properties: justify-content for the main axis and align-items for the cross axis.
